name: Shanghai INT Medical Instruments Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai INT Medical Instruments Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of cardiovascular interventional medical devices in Mainland China, Europe, the United States, and internationally. It offers transradial and femoral pressure bandage, hydrophilic guidewire, pressure Y-connector set, PTFE guidewire, PTCA balloon dilatation catheter, noncompliant balloon dilatation catheter, compression femoral artery tourniquet, vascular sheaths for single use, push-to-thread balloon dilation pressure pump, guide extension catheter, angiography catheter, guiding catheter, micro guidewire and catheter, cardiac valves balloon inflation cath…
